title: Ancient Ocean: The Fall of Atlantis
description:
Submerge into the ancient ocean of the Cambrian period! Encounter mysterious creatures of times past in this short-and-sweet platforming adventure. Treat yourself to colorful SNES-inspired graphics and an extensive world to explore. Who knows what awaits you?

StoryThe tranquil creatures of the Cambrian Ocean lived peacefully—until the empire of Atlantis attacked! The balance of the ocean was imperiled by the hands of the dreaded Emperor, until the chosen one came (That's you!). Platform your way through four vibrant worlds, defeat strange creatures, and restore peace to the ocean.   

Key Features• SNES-inspired graphics (256×224 pixel display)

• Vibrant colors

• 2D Platforming adventure

• Cambrian period creatures (including 3 bosses!)

• Collectibles to discover

• Upgrades to unlock
